chunks: From him, from Usman, from Sama'at who said:
I asked him about the dog, 'Can we keep it in the house?' He said: 'No'.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to keep a dog inside the house according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Sama'ah asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about keeping a dog in the house, receiving a direct negative response ('La'). This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between utility (like hunting or guarding) and domestic companionship, with many scholars interpreting the prohibition as specific to keeping them inside living quarters due to impurity (najāsah) or distraction from worship.

en.hubeali: From him, from Usman, from Sama’at who said,
‘I asked about the dog, ‘Can we keep it in the house?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ‘Uthman from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “
I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if we can keep a dog in the house. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, you must not do so.’”
